cohort: 116 pregnant women with CHD and 348 pregnant women without CHD
finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in women with CHD, particularly those with more severe CHD, while concerns about maternal deterioration leading to higher induction of labor rates seem unjustified.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was performed in 46.6% of pregnancies with CHD compared to 33.6% without CHD, and the rate increased with the severity of CHD.
